chapter: Birth, move to the city and first instruments
title: Buying his violin at 18 and starting on violin before clarinet
summary: Robinson places himself in Chennau at 18 and says violin was his first instrument, before clarinet; he played in various bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: 18 years old. Yeah. Yeah. Where were you then? I was in a place they called, uh, Chennau. It's from, uh, about, about 25 miles from New Road.
Up, up, upstate then. That's right. Uh, were you playing, uh, music at that time? Was that your first instrument? When did you, what instrument did you start on?

Me? Me? Yes. On, uh, violin. The violin came before the clarinet then? Yeah. After that I used to play in different, uh, bands, you know? Yes. With this one sometime, this one, this one, they'd come at me sometime, I'd hide from it. Yeah. I would stop going, uh, going out, you know?
